problem: The ski lodge gift shop had 75 woolly hats on Friday evening, spread over its 8 shelves. By Sunday afternoon, just 38 hats were left. How many hats did the shop sell over the weekend?
follow_up_questions: A van brought 40 more hats on Monday morning. How many hats did the shop have then?
Skiers bought 25 hats during the rest of Monday. How many hats were left at closing time?

problem: How many comic books did the corner newsstand sell between Friday evening and Sunday afternoon? Mr. Okafor, who has run the stand for 8 years, counted 75 comics on Friday evening and 38 on Sunday afternoon.
follow_up_questions: When a delivery of 40 comic books arrived on Monday morning, what was the newsstand's new total?
Readers bought 25 of them later on Monday. What number of comic books were left when the stand closed?

problem: When the ferry docked, 14 travellers on the pier walked on board. The remaining 11 decided to wait for the next ferry. Seagulls circled above the water. How many travellers had been waiting on the pier?
follow_up_questions: A little later, 6 more travellers arrived at the pier. How many travellers are waiting now?
The next ferry can carry 20 people from the pier. If all the waiting travellers board, how many empty places will it have?

problem: How many children stood in the roller coaster queue before the first car left? The car took 14 of them, and 11 had to wait for the next ride. The coaster track was painted bright red.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 more children joined the queue. What is the size of the queue now?
The next car has 20 seats. If every child in the queue gets on, how many seats stay empty?

problem: A farm shed held 96 sacks of chicken feed at the start of autumn. The hens ate through 38 sacks in the first month and 27 in the second. How many sacks were left for the third month?
follow_up_questions: The third month used 24 sacks. How many sacks were left after that?
Then the farmer bought 50 new sacks. How many sacks were in the shed?

problem: Find how many stamps Mei still has for her pen pals. Her stamp book started with 96 stamps; she used 38 on letters in January and 27 in February.
follow_up_questions: In March she stuck 24 stamps on letters. How many stamps are left in the book?
Her aunt then sent her 50 stamps. What is the number of stamps in the book now?

problem: The sports club owned 73 tennis rackets before the summer break. Members borrowed some for the holidays, and only 46 were left in the club storeroom. How many rackets did members borrow?
follow_up_questions: At the end of the break, 19 of the borrowed rackets came back. How many were still with members?
How many rackets were in the storeroom after the break ended?

problem: Only 46 of the town library's 73 umbrellas were on the stand at closing time on a rainy Monday; readers had taken the others home. What number of umbrellas went home with readers?
follow_up_questions: Over the next week, readers brought back 19 umbrellas. How many umbrellas are still out?
What is the number of umbrellas on the stand after that week?

problem: A dog ran across the playground, and 13 pigeons flew off while 8 kept pecking at crumbs. How many pigeons were on the playground before the dog came?
follow_up_questions: Later, 5 of the pigeons that flew off landed again. How many pigeons were on the playground then?

problem: Some deer were drinking at a pond when thunder rumbled. Eight of them kept drinking, but 13 ran into the trees. What was the number of deer at the pond before the thunder?
follow_up_questions: Once the storm passed, 5 of the deer that ran away came back to the pond. How many deer were at the pond then?

problem: Every morning Omar takes the tram, which needs 25 minutes to reach his office. Today the tram leaves the depot with 31 passengers, and 12 step off at the museum. How many passengers are still aboard?
follow_up_questions: At the library stop, 7 people climb on. How many passengers are on the tram now?
Omar steps off at the bridge along with 9 other passengers. How many passengers remain on the tram?

problem: How many people are left on the river boat after the zoo pier, if it set off with 31 people and 12 got off at the zoo? The whole ride lasts 25 minutes, and Bea rides it every Sunday.
follow_up_questions: At the castle pier, 7 more people come aboard. How many people are on the boat?
Bea and 9 other people leave the boat at the market pier. How many people stay on the boat?

problem: A trolley carrying 42 shoppers rolled out of the mall station on Saturday. After the stop at the cinema, only 27 shoppers were left on it. How many shoppers got off at the cinema altogether?
Altogether, how many campers climbed out of the camp truck at the lake? The truck had carried 42 campers from the gate, and 27 were still inside when it drove on.

A bakery's cookie jar held 19 cookies on Thursday morning. Nobody had filled it since Monday night, and customers bought 34 cookies from it on Tuesday and 28 on Wednesday. How many cookies were in the jar on Monday night?
follow_up_questions: On Thursday afternoon the baker added 45 fresh cookies to the jar. How many cookies are in it now?
On Friday customers bought 37 cookies from the jar. How many were left by Friday evening?

problem: What was the number of pencils in the classroom pot on Monday night? By Thursday morning there were only 19, because pupils took 34 on Tuesday and 28 on Wednesday, and no one put any back.
follow_up_questions: On Thursday afternoon the teacher dropped 45 new pencils into the pot. How many pencils does it hold now?
During Friday, pupils took 37 of them. How many pencils were in the pot at the end of Friday?

problem: Juno's sailing club loaded 24 juice boxes onto their boat for a 2-day trip on the lake, and the sailors finished 17 of them on the first day. How many juice boxes were left for the second day?
follow_up_questions: The sailors drank 5 juice boxes on the second day. How many did they bring back to shore?
Back at the club, Juno's dad put 12 new juice boxes in the cooler with the ones they brought back. How many juice boxes are in the cooler?
The sailors take 8 of them to Saturday's race. How many juice boxes stay in the cooler?

problem: On the first day of a 2-day road trip, the Lopez family ate 17 of the 24 sandwiches they had packed. How many sandwiches did they have for the second day?
follow_up_questions: They ate 5 sandwiches on the second day. How many sandwiches came home with them?
At home, Mrs. Lopez made 12 more and put them in the fridge with the leftovers. How many sandwiches are in the fridge?
The children take 8 of them to the park on Saturday. How many sandwiches are left in the fridge?

problem: The school fair, now in its 8th year, opened at ten o'clock with 56 paper lanterns hanging along the hall. By two o'clock only 29 lanterns were still hanging. How many lanterns had fallen down or been taken?
follow_up_questions: Then each visitor took one lantern home, and after that 4 lanterns were still hanging. How many visitors took a lantern?
Ms. Ito, who ran the fair, kept the lanterns that were still hanging, and the next day a parent gave her 6 more. How many lanterns does Ms. Ito have now?

problem: What number of flags went missing from the railings during the town parade? Before the 8 marching bands set off, 56 flags were tied along the railings; afterwards, 29 were left.
follow_up_questions: Every child watching then untied one flag to keep, which left 4 on the railings. How many children took a flag?
The mayor took home the flags left on the railings and later received 6 more as a gift. How many flags does the mayor have?

problem: After the class picnic, Mr. Kowalski had only 6 sandwiches left. The children had eaten 18 of the sandwiches he made that morning. How many sandwiches had he made?
follow_up_questions: He gave half of the leftover sandwiches to the school caretaker. How many sandwiches did the caretaker get?

problem: Uncle Ravi picked strawberries for the family. How many did he pick, if the cousins ate 18 at tea time and 6 were still in the bowl afterwards?
follow_up_questions: He gave half of the strawberries in the bowl to the neighbour's children. How many strawberries did they receive?

problem: Ninety-one fans filled the stands for the morning football match. When it ended, 47 of them left the stadium. How many fans stayed for the afternoon?
follow_up_questions: Before the second match, 28 more fans arrived. How many fans were in the stands then?
Just before kick-off, 15 fans left to catch a train. How many fans watched the second match?
After the final whistle, all but 9 of those fans went home. How many of them went home?

problem: Find how many people were still in the park after 47 of the 91 puppet-show watchers went home at noon.
follow_up_questions: Then 28 more people came for the evening concert. How many people were in the park?
Before the concert began, 15 people left. How many people heard the concert?
When the music stopped, everyone except 9 of the listeners left the park. How many listeners left?

problem: Twenty-five children started the school cross-country race, but only 17 crossed the finish line; the rest stopped at the water station. The finish line had a big blue arch. How many children stopped at the water station?
follow_up_questions: Of the children who stopped, 3 sat down in the shade. How many of them did not sit in the shade?

problem: How many divers stayed on the boat? A group of 25 divers came out to the reef, and 17 of them jumped into the water. The sea was a deep shade of green.
follow_up_questions: Of the divers who stayed on the boat, 3 went fishing off the side. How many of them did not go fishing?

problem: Hiro traded away 12 of his marbles at school on Friday and kept the other 19. He had won all of them at the fair on Thursday. How many marbles did he win at the fair?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday he won 8 more marbles. How many marbles does he have now?
He puts 20 marbles in a glass jar on his shelf. How many of his marbles are not in the jar?

problem: Find the number of acorns Greta collected in the forest. Afterwards she gave 12 to the squirrels in her garden and kept 19 for a craft.
follow_up_questions: The next day she picked up 8 more acorns. How many acorns does she have?
She paints 20 acorns for her craft. How many of her acorns are not painted?

problem: There were 27 bicycles in the rack outside the station at seven in the morning. By nine, commuters had ridden off on 14 of them. How many bicycles were still in the rack?
How many paddle boats were left at the lake pier by lunchtime? The pier had 27 boats at sunrise, and families took out 14 before lunch.
Sushi plates were moving along the restaurant's belt. Diners took 23 of them, and 9 kept going round. How many plates were on the belt at first?
follow_up_questions: Then the chef put 14 new plates on the belt. How many plates are on it now?
By closing time, diners had taken every plate on the belt except 3. How many had they taken since the chef added the new ones?

problem: What was the number of parcels on the post office conveyor before the workers started? Workers lifted 23 parcels off, leaving 9 still moving along it.
follow_up_questions: A truck then unloaded 14 parcels onto the conveyor. How many parcels are on it?
By evening, all of the parcels on the conveyor except 3 had been lifted off. How many parcels were lifted off after the truck came?

problem: A scout troop bought 60 badges for the year. They gave out 36 at the autumn camp and 15 at the winter fair. How many badges did the troop have left?
follow_up_questions: The three patrol leaders share the leftover badges equally. How many badges does each leader get?

problem: Mrs. Banda's class had 60 gold stars. Find how many stars were left after she handed out 36 on Monday and another 15 on Tuesday.
follow_up_questions: She shares the remaining stars equally among three helpers. How many stars does each helper get?

problem: The museum's leaflet stand held 40 leaflets when the doors opened. The museum has a huge dinosaur skeleton in the main hall. When the guard checked at closing time, 26 leaflets were left. How many leaflets had visitors taken?
follow_up_questions: The next day visitors took 9 more leaflets. How many leaflets were left on the stand?

problem: A basket of free apples by the gym door had 40 apples at breakfast time and 26 at dinner time. The gym had just been painted white. How many apples did people take?
follow_up_questions: On the following day people took 9 more apples. How many apples were left in the basket?

problem: A city tram let off 26 passengers at the first stop and 19 at the second. After that, 13 passengers were still riding. How many passengers were on the tram when it left the depot?
follow_up_questions: At the third stop, 8 passengers got off. How many passengers were left on the tram?
How many passengers got off at the first three stops in all?
The next morning the tram leaves the depot with the same passengers as before plus 4 new ones. How many passengers are on it?

problem: How many bags of rice were on the delivery truck when it left the warehouse? It dropped off 26 bags at the first shop and 19 at the second shop, and then it still had 13 bags in the back.
follow_up_questions: At the third shop the driver unloaded 8 bags. How many bags were still in the truck?
How many bags were unloaded at the three shops altogether?
Tomorrow the truck will carry as many bags as it had when it left the warehouse, plus 4 more. How many bags will it carry?

problem: A lake had 93 rowing boats for rent at the start of the season. During a storm that lasted 6 hours, 28 of them sank. How many boats were still afloat?
What is the number of street lamps still working in the town? The town had 93 street lamps until lightning during a 6-day storm broke 28 of them.
'Grab a free map before you go!' the museum guide said. She had stacked 30 maps on the desk that morning, and at closing time 7 were left. How many maps did visitors take?
follow_up_questions: The guide gave 4 of the leftover maps to a school group. How many maps were still on the desk?
Including the ones given to the school group, how many maps left the desk altogether?

problem: Out of 30 cupcakes Ana set on the bake sale table, only 7 were left when the sale ended. How many cupcakes did people buy?
follow_up_questions: Ana gave 4 of the leftover cupcakes to the caretaker. How many were still on the table?
How many cupcakes in total went from the table, counting the caretaker's?

problem: Mr. Silva pulled 7 nails from a jar to hang 4 pictures. Now the jar holds 17 nails. How many nails were in the jar to begin with?
How many crayons were in the tin before Zoe took out 7 to draw a rainbow? The art lesson starts at 2 o'clock, and the tin now holds 17 crayons.
Twenty-two sailboats were out on the bay one sunny afternoon. When a storm cloud appeared, 15 of them sailed back to the harbour. How many sailboats were still out on the bay?
How many fireflies were still in the jar? Kenta caught twenty-two fireflies at dusk, and at bedtime he let 15 of them fly away.
Lena put 32 goldfish into the garden pond in spring. Herons caught some, and in autumn she could count only 25. How many fish had the herons caught?
follow_up_questions: Lena added 10 new goldfish to the pond. How many goldfish are in it now?

problem: How many chairs were borrowed from the hall? On Monday a teacher set out 32 chairs there for a concert, but by Tuesday morning she could count only 25.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday she brought in 10 more chairs. How many chairs are in the hall now?

problem: Some families were waiting for the cable car at the bottom of the mountain. The first car carried 11 people up, and 7 had to wait for the next one. How many people had been waiting at the bottom?
follow_up_questions: Before the next car came, 5 more people joined the line. How many were waiting then?
The next car could carry only 9 people. How many people were still waiting after it went up?
A third car took everyone who was left, plus 6 people who rushed up at the last moment. How many people rode the third car?

problem: A queue formed at the ice-cream van. Find how many people were in it, if the first 11 got their cones and walked away and 7 were still waiting.
follow_up_questions: Then 5 more people joined the queue. How many people were waiting?
The van had only enough cones for 9 more people. After those were served, how many people were still in the queue?
A second van arrived and served everyone left in the queue, plus 6 people who came running from the beach. How many people did the second van serve?

problem: I packed 36 crackers for the long car ride to Grandma's. When we arrived, 21 were left. Grandma's house has a red door. How many crackers did I eat on the way?
How many grapes did Tomas eat during the film? He started with a bowl of 36 grapes, and at the end there were 21. The film was about a brave little fox.
The art class used 17 tubes of paint on Monday and 26 on Tuesday. That left 38 tubes for Wednesday. How many tubes of paint did the class start the week with?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday the class used 22 tubes. How many tubes were left at the end of the week?
The teacher put the leftover tubes into a box that already held 25 tubes. How many tubes are in the box now?

problem: How many logs had the family stacked by the cabin fireplace at the start of their stay? They burned 17 logs on the first evening and 26 on the second, and 38 were still stacked for the last evening.
follow_up_questions: They burned 22 logs on the last evening. How many logs were left in the stack?
They carried the leftover logs out to the woodshed, where 25 logs were already piled. How many logs are in the woodshed?

problem: Twenty-eight cyclists set off on a 9-lap race around the park. After a few laps, 12 of them stopped to rest. How many cyclists kept riding?
follow_up_questions: Of the cyclists who kept riding, 5 got flat tyres and dropped out. How many finished the race?

problem: How many swimmers carried on across the lake? A group of 28 swimmers set out at 9 in the morning, and 12 of them climbed onto the support boat halfway.
follow_up_questions: Of those who carried on, 5 got too cold and stopped before the far shore. How many swimmers reached the far shore?

problem: The night train left the capital with 63 passengers. When it pulled into the final station, only 18 passengers were still on board. What was the total number of passengers who got off at earlier stations?
follow_up_questions: Of those passengers, 27 got off at the seaside town. How many got off at the other stations?
Each passenger who got off at the seaside town had paid 2 dollars for a snack on the train. How many dollars did those passengers pay for snacks?

problem: Find the total number of tourists who left the cruise ship before its last port. It sailed with 63 tourists, and 18 were still aboard when it docked at the last port.
follow_up_questions: Of the tourists who left, 27 left at the island port. How many left at the other ports?
Each tourist who left at the island port paid 2 dollars for a bus ticket. How many dollars was that in all?

problem: Mr. Patel pumped up beach balls for sports day the night before. By morning 16 had leaked flat, and during the games 23 more burst, so 35 were left at the end of the day. Sports day was held on the big field. How many beach balls had Mr. Patel pumped up?
follow_up_questions: He gave 2 of the leftover balls to each of the 9 classes. How many balls did he keep?
A week later, 8 of the balls he kept had gone flat. How many were still full of air?

problem: How many paper lanterns did Aunt Rosa make for the street festival? Before the festival, 16 got torn in the rain, and during it 23 more were damaged, which left 35 good lanterns at the end. Rosa loves the colour gold.
follow_up_questions: She gave 2 of the good lanterns to each of her 9 neighbours. How many lanterns did she keep?
By the next week, 8 of the lanterns she kept had faded. How many still looked bright?

problem: Mr. Okoro baked bread rolls on Saturday. He gave 14 to his friends and has 15 left. His oven is very old. How many rolls did he bake?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday he used 6 rolls for sandwiches. How many rolls are left now?

problem: What number of eggs did the hens lay this week, if Farmer Ana sold 14 at the market and still has 15 in her kitchen? The hens love to sit in the sun.
follow_up_questions: She used 6 of the eggs in a cake. How many eggs are left in her kitchen?

problem: A souvenir stall at the zoo had 41 toy lions before the school holidays. The stall stands beside the penguin pool. During the first week of the holidays it sold 25 of them. How many toy lions did the stall have left after that week?
How many raincoats were left at the beach shop after Sunday, if it had 41 raincoats before the weekend and sold 25 on Sunday? The shop has a striped awning.
Before the race, Eva stuck 19 stars onto her bike helmet. After the muddy ride, only 11 stars were still on. How many stars had fallen off?
follow_up_questions: Eva stuck 6 new stars on the helmet. How many stars are on it now?

problem: How many leaves did the wind blow off Ben's leaf collage? He glued 19 leaves onto it in the morning, but after it hung by the open window all afternoon, only 11 stayed on.
follow_up_questions: Ben glued 6 fresh leaves onto the collage. How many leaves does it have now?

problem: A rabbit sneaked into Mr. Gupta's vegetable patch on Thursday. It ate 6 lettuces, and Mr. Gupta counted 21 still growing. How many lettuces had been growing before the rabbit came?
follow_up_questions: On Friday Mr. Gupta picked 9 lettuces for the market. How many are still growing?
Over the weekend he planted 8 new lettuces. How many lettuces are growing on Monday?
He wants 30 lettuces in the patch by summer. How many more must he plant?

problem: How many paper cranes hung in the classroom window before the storm on Thursday? The wind blew 6 of them away, and 21 were still hanging.
follow_up_questions: On Friday, Ms. Kaur took down 9 cranes to give to a hospital. How many cranes are still hanging?
Over the weekend the class folded 8 new cranes and hung them up. How many cranes hang there on Monday?
The class wants 30 cranes in the window. How many more cranes must they fold?

problem: A pizza for the class party was cut into 24 slices, and the children ate 17 before the film started. How many slices were left for after the film?
How many crackers did Noor save for later? Her box had 24 crackers, and she and her friends ate 17 at the picnic.
Kito took 20 pencils to a 3-day art camp and came home with 13. How many pencils did he lose at camp?
follow_up_questions: Before the next camp he bought a box of 10 pencils. How many pencils does he have now?

problem: How many tent pegs went missing? Mr. Haddad packed 20 tent pegs for a camping trip, and when he unpacked 3 days later he counted only 13.
follow_up_questions: He bought a bag of 10 new pegs before his next trip. How many pegs does he have now?

problem: When a cat crept into the garden, 9 sparrows flew up into the tree, and only 6 stayed on the bird feeder. How many sparrows had been on the feeder before the cat came?
follow_up_questions: After the cat left, 4 sparrows flew back down to the feeder. How many sparrows are on the feeder now?

problem: How many turtles had been sunning themselves on the log? A loud splash scared 9 of them into the pond, and 6 stayed on the log.
follow_up_questions: When it was quiet again, 4 turtles climbed back onto the log. How many turtles are on the log now?

problem: Seventy-two students rode the school coach to the city. Of them, 35 hopped off at the aquarium for the afternoon, and the rest rode on to the zoo. How many students went to the zoo?
follow_up_questions: At five o'clock the coach came back for the aquarium group, but 6 of those students went home with their parents instead. How many students got back on the coach at the aquarium?

problem: Find how many campers stayed on the ferry to the far island. The ferry left the harbour with 72 campers, and 35 got off at the first island to camp there.
follow_up_questions: Later the ferry went back for the first-island campers, but 6 of them stayed an extra night. How many campers boarded the ferry at the first island?

problem: At lunchtime there were 34 deck chairs out on the pool terrace, but by evening there were only 9. How many deck chairs were folded up and taken away?
follow_up_questions: The hotel staff took away 15 of them, and guests took the rest. How many deck chairs did guests take?
The next morning the staff set out all the chairs they had taken away, plus 4 new ones. How many chairs did the staff set out?

problem: Between morning and evening, how many market stalls were packed up? In the morning 34 stalls stood in the square, and in the evening only 9 were left.
follow_up_questions: Farmers packed up 15 of them, and craft sellers packed up the rest. How many stalls did craft sellers pack up?
The next morning the farmers set up all their stalls again, plus 4 new ones. How many farmers' stalls stood in the square?

problem: During the autumn term the art students broke 27 paintbrushes, and in the winter term they broke 18 more. Each broken brush was replaced with one from the supply cupboard, which now has 34 brushes. How many brushes were in the cupboard at the start of autumn?
follow_up_questions: In spring the teacher orders 40 new brushes for the cupboard. How many brushes does it hold then?
During spring the students take 29 brushes from the cupboard. How many are left for the summer club?
The summer club needs 50 brushes. How many brushes short is the cupboard?

problem: The football coach keeps spare balls in a net. How many were in the net in September, if the team lost 27 balls in the autumn and 18 in the winter, each one replaced from the net, and the net now holds 34?
follow_up_questions: In March the coach buys 40 new balls for the net. How many balls are in it?
The team takes 29 balls out of the net during the spring. How many are left for the summer camp?
The summer camp needs 50 balls. How many balls is the net short?

problem: A school garden had 45 sunflowers in bud. Heavy hail on Monday broke the buds on 13 of them. How many sunflowers still had buds on Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: By July, 10 of those sunflowers had opened. How many had not opened yet?
A week later, all but 5 of the others had opened too. How many more sunflowers opened that week?
How many sunflowers had opened by the end of that week?

problem: How many tomato plants in the greenhouse still had flowers after the heater broke on a cold night? There had been 45 plants in flower, and the cold killed the flowers on 13 of them.
follow_up_questions: By June, 10 of the flowering plants had red tomatoes. How many plants had none yet?
A week later, all but 5 of those plants had red tomatoes too. How many plants turned red that week?
How many plants had red tomatoes once that week was over?

problem: Twenty balloons were let go at the start of the balloon race, but only 12 floated over the hill. The rest got stuck in the trees. How many balloons got stuck?
follow_up_questions: The children pulled 5 of the stuck balloons out of the trees. How many balloons are still stuck?

problem: How many toy cars crashed off the track? At the school race, twenty cars started down the ramp, and 12 made it to the bottom without crashing.
follow_up_questions: The children picked up 5 of the crashed cars and fixed them. How many crashed cars are still broken?

problem: On Sunday morning, 37 guests checked out of the seaside hotel, and 48 guests stayed on. How many guests had been at the hotel on Saturday night?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday afternoon, 26 new guests checked in. How many guests were at the hotel on Sunday night?
By Monday evening, 59 guests had checked out. How many guests were still at the hotel?

problem: What was the number of skaters on the ice rink before the break? When the music stopped, 37 skaters left the ice and 48 kept skating.
follow_up_questions: After the break, 26 more skaters came onto the ice. How many skaters were on the rink then?
By closing time, 59 of them had gone home. How many were still skating?

problem: Tariq picked 16 ripe plums to make jam. Before that, the plum tree in his yard, which is 4 metres tall, had 38 ripe plums. How many ripe plums are left on the tree?
follow_up_questions: Overnight, wasps spoiled 7 of them. How many good plums are left on the tree?

problem: Find how many cherries are still on the bush in Mira's yard. There were 38 ripe cherries until Mira and her 4 cousins picked 16.
follow_up_questions: By morning, birds had pecked away 7 of them. How many cherries are left on the bush?

problem: The first ferry of the morning left the harbour with 26 passengers. No one boarded on the way, but some passengers got off at the small islands. When it reached the main island, the captain counted 14 passengers. How many had got off at the small islands?
follow_up_questions: At the main island, 9 people boarded. How many passengers were on the ferry then?
At the lighthouse pier, 17 passengers got off. How many were still on the ferry?

problem: How many children left the school bus before the library stop? The bus picked up 26 children at school and nobody else got on, but at the library stop only 14 were still aboard.
follow_up_questions: At the library, 9 children got on. How many children were on the bus then?
At the swimming pool, 17 children got off. How many were still riding?

problem: After a 5-hour day of berry picking, Ama made jam. She gave 8 jars to her aunt and put 11 jars in her own pantry. How many jars of jam did Ama make?
follow_up_questions: Her family opens 4 of the pantry jars over the winter. How many jars are left in the pantry?

problem: How many pumpkins did Mr. Lund grow? He has been gardening for 5 years; this year he gave 8 pumpkins to the school and stored 11 in his barn.
follow_up_questions: He carves 4 of the stored pumpkins for a festival. How many pumpkins are left in his barn?

problem: On Saturday the pet shop had 85 goldfish in its tanks, and by closing time 49 had been sold. The shop smelled of fish food all day. When it closed, how many goldfish were left in the tanks?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday it sold 19 more goldfish. How many goldfish were left?
On Monday a delivery brings 60 new goldfish. How many goldfish does the shop have then?

problem: How many tickets were still unsold when the box office closed? The theatre had 85 tickets for Friday's show, and 49 were sold during the day. A tall clock ticked loudly in the lobby.
follow_up_questions: On Saturday morning 19 more tickets were sold. How many tickets were left?
The theatre then added 60 tickets for an extra show. How many tickets did it have to sell?

problem: The school's lost-property box held 64 water bottles in October. By March only 47 were left, because children had claimed the others. How many water bottles had been claimed?
follow_up_questions: Over the spring, 25 more bottles are handed in to the box. How many bottles will it hold by summer?

problem: In January the ski school had 64 helmets, but by April it could find only 47. How many helmets had gone missing over the winter?
follow_up_questions: Before next winter the ski school buys 25 new helmets. How many helmets will it have?

problem: Lucy gave some of her stickers to her classmates, so she ended the day with 9 fewer than she started with. She had 7 stickers left. How many stickers did she start the day with?
follow_up_questions: Her brother gave her 5 of his stickers. How many stickers does she have now?

problem: How many seashells did Omar's bucket hold this morning? It holds 9 fewer now, since he shared some with his cousins, and there are 7 shells left in it.
follow_up_questions: His aunt dropped 5 more shells into the bucket. How many shells are in it now?

problem: The zoo keeper started the day with 75 fish in a bucket for the seals. All morning she added up how many she had thrown to them, and by noon the count was 38. How many fish were left in the bucket at noon?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon she threw 29 more fish to the seals. How many fish are left?
She got 40 fresh fish for the next day. How many fish will she have then?

problem: How many nails were left in the carpenter's box at lunchtime? The box held 75 nails at the start of the day, and Mr. Brandt kept adding up the nails he hammered in: 38 by lunchtime.
follow_up_questions: He hammered in 29 more nails in the afternoon. How many nails are left in the box?
He bought 40 nails for the next job. How many nails will he have then?

problem: The zoo's petting farm had 90 bags of goat food in spring. By summer the goats had eaten through some of them, and 54 bags were left. How many bags had the goats eaten?

problem: Work out how many books the school library lent out in March. At the start of March it had 90 books on the shelves, and by the end of the month only 54 were there.
follow_up_questions: In April a parent gave the library 28 books, which went on the shelves. How many books were on the shelves then?

problem: Halfway through football practice, 6 players left for the team photo, and 14 players kept training. How many players were at practice before anyone left?

problem: What number of bananas did the school snack table still have at the end of morning break? It started the day with 40 bananas, and the children took 24 during the break.
follow_up_questions: During the lunch break, children took 13 more bananas. How many were left after lunch?

problem: The garden centre had 58 clay pots stacked outside before the storm. Afterwards only 39 were whole; the wind had knocked over and cracked the rest. How many pots cracked?
follow_up_questions: The centre orders 25 new pots. How many whole pots does it have now?

problem: How many of the café's 58 glasses broke during the busy weekend, if only 39 glasses went back on the shelf on Monday?
follow_up_questions: The owner buys 25 new glasses. How many glasses does the café have now?

problem: At the start of the school play, an usher had a pile of programmes. She gave out 23 before the curtain went up, and then 12 were left in her pile. How many programmes did she start with?

problem: Find how many raffle tickets were in Coach Ahmed's book this morning. He has sold 23 tickets so far, and 12 are still in the book.
follow_up_questions: This afternoon he sells 8 more tickets. How many tickets are still in the book?

problem: A ferry reached the island at noon with 48 passengers. More and more people crowded to the ramp, and in the first ten minutes 27 of them walked off. How many passengers were still on the ferry?

problem: How many people were still in the cinema? The film ended with 48 people in their seats, and more and more of them hurried out: 27 in the first few minutes.

problem: On Friday 96 children took 3 trains to the music festival. In the evening only 59 of them came back by train, because families drove the others home. How many children went home by car?

problem: Work out how many hikers walked back down the mountain. Of the 96 hikers who climbed it in 3 groups, 59 rode the cable car down.
follow_up_questions: Of the hikers who walked down, 18 were in the youth club. How many were not in the youth club?

problem: Mina sold 25 cookies at the school bake sale for 2 dollars each. At the end she had 13 cookies left. How many cookies did she bring?

problem: How many bags of popcorn were left at the cinema after the weekend shows? The snack bar had 74 bags before the shows, and it sold 26 at the Saturday show and 31 at the Sunday show.

If 20 bags are sold at Monday's show, how many will remain?

problem: Thirty-four volunteers showed up to clean the beach in the morning, but just 19 were still there at lunch. In total, how many volunteers had left by lunch?

follow_up_questions: In the evening she sold all but 3 of the pretzels that were left. How many did she sell in the evening?

problem: What number of balloons did the clown have when the fair opened, if he gave away 26 in the morning and had 14 left by noon?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon he gave away all but 3 of the remaining balloons. How many balloons did he give away in the afternoon?

problem: The canteen cook made 72 sandwiches before school and found just 18 on the counter after lunch. Her kitchen has 12 cupboards. How many sandwiches did the pupils take?

problem: How many pens were in the teacher's cup at the start of the test? The pupils took away 12 pens to write with, and only 6 stayed in the cup.

problem: The bus depot has 4 gates, and at dawn 37 buses were parked inside. By noon, 18 buses had driven out on their routes. How many were still parked at noon?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon, 11 buses came back and parked. How many buses are parked now?

problem: How many boats were still tied up in the marina at noon? At sunrise there were 37, and 18 sailed out during the morning. The marina has 4 fuel pumps.
follow_up_questions: During the afternoon, 11 boats came in and tied up. How many boats are in the marina now?

problem: Ana took 50 dollars to the funfair. After paying for rides she had 38 dollars. How much did the rides cost her altogether?

problem: Altogether, how much did Mr. Chen spend at the hardware shop, if his wallet held 50 dollars when he went in and 38 dollars when he came out?

problem: How many boxes of strawberries were left at the farm stand at closing time? The stand began the day with 27 boxes, and customers bought 19. A friendly cat slept by the till.

problem: The gumball machine at the toy shop was full with 40 gumballs when the shop opened. By lunchtime, children had bought 23. What is the total number of gumballs left in the machine?

problem: Jun put 14 photos into his holiday album, and 9 photos are still in the envelope. How many photos did he have before he started the album?
